doc.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Europe, Los Angeles and the Legrand break
title: The Los Angeles year: pool, ring modulator and Donte's
summary: The failed move to L.A., a house with a pool, and an avant-garde band.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah but I mean it was a chance to experiment, you know. And I got it out of my system. I mean, I took it as far as I could at that level and then when I left Europe and, and for some odd reason I moved to L.A. which was… I always wanted to have a house with a pool, I’ll never, I’ll never want that again, you know spend all day worrying about the pH factor, you know. [Laughs]
I was at a clinic of yours and you started the clinic by saying that, that “If you don’t learn anything today, don’t get a house with a pool.”

Don’t get a house with a pool. And my son just bought a house with a pool, but he’s good at it. But I mean even though when I went to L.A. I started a real avant-garde band. I had uh that’s when I had the ring modulator with Pete Robinson and we were really out, really out.

Very out, very out. But L.A. got to, that’s when I found out that I was not an L.A. guy. I mean, I remember the club, Dontes was the famous jazz club in the valley [telephone rings] Oh, you wanna get that? [Recorder is shut off]
Yeah, so I remember being in uh, when I was in L.A., uh a local the local, Donte’s, the local jazz
